source_catalog.CITADEL_ORIGINAL_FOUNDATION: Original CITADEL operational definitions recorded as unvalidated hypotheses.
source_catalog.CITADEL_RUNTIME_CONTRACT: Existing CITADEL read-only runtime semantics; no execution authority is implied.

entries.definition: A descriptive ordering of confirmed swing highs and lows on one identified instrument and timeframe.
entries.rule: Assign structure context only from chronological completed candles with explicit swing references.
valid_conditions: All referenced candles are completed and ordered.
invalidation: A referenced candle is missing, forming, duplicated, or out of order.
when_not_to_use: Do not use as an entry instruction or probability estimate.
entries.testable_hypothesis: Given the same ordered completed candles and swing rule, repeated classification produces the same structure label.

entries.definition: A close-confirmed statement references the final close of an identified completed candle.
valid_conditions: Candle completion and timestamp semantics are authoritative.
invalidation: The candle is forming or its close timestamp is unavailable.
when_not_to_use: Do not treat intrabar movement as close confirmation.
entries.testable_hypothesis: Removing the final completed candle removes any confirmation that depends exclusively on its close.

entries.definition: A mapped area around explicit prior price references that may be monitored for later interaction.
entries.rule: A pool exists only while every originating reference and its instrument identity remain available.
valid_conditions: Reference prices and timestamps are explicit.
All references belong to the same instrument context.
invalidation: Reference identity is lost or the mapping source becomes unavailable.
when_not_to_use: Do not infer reversal, continuation, or order intent from a pool alone.
entries.testable_hypothesis: The same reference set and mapping rule produce the same bounded liquidity context.

entries.definition: An option observation is scoped to one security ID, expiry, strike, and CE or PE type.
valid_conditions: All four identity fields are authoritative and mutually consistent.
invalidation: Any identity field is missing or conflicts with the instrument master.
when_not_to_use: Do not substitute a current ATM contract for a previously observed or held contract.
entries.testable_hypothesis: Changing any identity field creates a distinct contract context without altering the prior record.

entries.definition: Open-interest change is the difference between current authoritative OI and an explicitly identified prior authoritative OI.
entries.rule: oi_change = current_oi - prior_oi; unavailable when either operand is unavailable.
valid_conditions: Current and prior snapshots share contract identity.
invalidation: Prior OI is missing, stale beyond policy, or belongs to another contract.
when_not_to_use: Do not label buyer or seller intent from OI change without independent price and trade context.
entries.testable_hypothesis: For a fixed current and prior snapshot, OI change is reproducible and becomes unavailable when the prior snapshot is removed.

entries.definition: A timestamped description of reported implied-volatility or VIX inputs without directional inference.
entries.rule: A comparison is available only when values, scopes, and baseline timestamps are reported.
valid_conditions: Source, scope, and timestamps are explicit.
Compared observations use a deterministic baseline.
invalidation: A required volatility value or baseline is unavailable.
when_not_to_use: Do not convert volatility level or change into direction, win probability, or expected return.
entries.testable_hypothesis: Removing a required baseline changes the comparison output to unavailable rather than zero.

entries.definition: A read-only interpretation of canonical VOB zones and their reported lifecycle events.
entries.rule: Use the existing VOB projection unchanged; report no event that is absent from its canonical lifecycle.
valid_conditions: VOB source is authoritative for the same instrument and timeframe.
invalidation: VOB source is stale, unavailable, or evaluated through a forming bucket.
when_not_to_use: Do not recalculate VOB, invent zones, or use a zone as execution authorization.
entries.testable_hypothesis: The vault interpretation preserves every canonical zone value and lifecycle label without numerical modification.

entries.definition: A read-only description of canonical ARGUS option-flow evidence, freshness, and agreement.
entries.rule: Preserve ARGUS status and provenance; unavailable or stale inputs remain explicitly unavailable or stale.
valid_conditions: ARGUS snapshot identity and source timestamp are reported.
Interpretation uses canonical backend fields only.
invalidation: Snapshot identity is missing or stale output is represented as live.
when_not_to_use: Do not present evidence quality as win probability or ARGUS as execution authorization.
entries.testable_hypothesis: Canonical ARGUS and vault-rendered status, freshness, and evidence labels remain identical.

entries.definition: A descriptive record of whether independently sourced completed observations agree.
entries.rule: alignment = reported only when every named input is available and its explicit state agrees; otherwise report conflict or unavailable.
valid_conditions: Every named input has source and freshness metadata.
invalidation: Any required input is stale, unavailable, or contradictory.
when_not_to_use: Do not convert alignment into a setup score, order, or forced trade.
entries.testable_hypothesis: Introducing one contradictory required input changes agreement to conflict without changing the source observations.

entries.definition: A source-dependent interpretation is invalid when its required source identity or freshness cannot be verified.
entries.rule: valid = required_sources_present AND identities_match AND freshness_within_policy.
valid_conditions: Required source identities and timestamps are available.
invalidation: Any required source is missing, mismatched, or stale beyond its explicit policy.
when_not_to_use: Do not use this rule to alter strategy, risk, order, or broker state.
entries.testable_hypothesis: Removing one required source changes the interpretation to unavailable without substituting a value.

entries.definition: A boundary requiring any strike context to preserve the contract selected by an existing authoritative component.
entries.rule: The vault may reference but never select, rotate, or replace an option contract.
valid_conditions: Security ID, expiry, strike, and option type are supplied by an authoritative existing source.
invalidation: Contract identity is incomplete or internally inconsistent.
when_not_to_use: Do not use as a contract-selection algorithm or recommendation.
entries.testable_hypothesis: A contract rollover creates a new identity while the prior contract reference remains unchanged.

entries.definition: A read-only explanation boundary for already reported risk limits, exposure, and availability.
entries.rule: Risk fields are copied from their authoritative source or reported unavailable; the vault performs no mutation.
valid_conditions: Risk source and timestamp are explicit.
invalidation: Risk data is absent, stale, or lacks source identity.
when_not_to_use: Do not authorize, block, size, submit, or modify a trade.
entries.testable_hypothesis: Reading or searching this item leaves risk, order, fill, position, and mission state byte-identical.
